scope.scope: 604 Malay and 600 Indonesian entries with starting decoded localized text at most 100 characters; exact reviewed English and resulting localized value; resource aliases count only as aliases, not review of their long targets.

limits: Independent reviewer identity or a separate complete-reviewer output is not established by this author/source-comparison document.
Unchanged rows mean no additional edit proposed; not native-speaker acceptance.
No complete long-target review is inherited from an alias.
No current consumer-code or runtime/rendering acceptance follows from source/target equality.
Three complete manuals and remaining long entries were not comprehensively reviewed.
The withdrawn September broad audit is not restored.
